observations: Photo 0: One wooden pallet on a concrete floor; visible wear and some discoloration; no clear brand markings besides a watermark overlay.
Photo 1: Another view of a wooden pallet; similar construction; visible gaps/holes in deck boards; watermark overlay present.
Photo 2: Stack of multiple wooden pallets in a warehouse; pallets look mixed in condition (some boards look darker/used).

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show wooden pallets suitable for storage/handling.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show pallets, but cannot confirm dryness, whether any water was added, or whether they are fully sorted across the whole quantity.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale ticket/receipt or photo of the certified weighing is provided.

risks.risk: Quantity/weight mismatch (seller may not actually have 500 kg, or includes damaged/low-value pieces).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the pallets being weighed on the certified scale with the scale reading visible, plus a receipt or scale calibration/ID.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller/unknown quantity of used wooden pallets (worst case: not guaranteed 500 kg).

risks.risk: Condition issues: broken boards, weak stringers, or heavy damage that reduces usability.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of the underside and corners of at least 3-5 pallets showing any cracks, missing boards, or repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used pallets with possible wear/damage (worst case: not fully intact).

risks.risk: Moisture/infestation risk (wood pallets can have dampness, mold, or pests not obvious in photos).
risks.proof: Moisture meter reading (photo of meter on wood) and a close-up of any dark spots; also show one pallet board surface in bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven dry/clean (worst case: treat as standard used pallets without a dryness guarantee).

risks.risk: Potential treatment/legality for export (e.g., HT vs MB) if buyer needs compliant pallets.
risks.proof: Photo of the stamp/marking on at least one pallet (IPPC/HT/MB code) on the stringer.
risks.if_unproven: Price without compliance assurance (worst case: no proof of HT/IPPC marking).

proof_requests: Send a photo/video of the certified scale weighing showing the total weight reading (for the exact quantity being sold).
Show close-ups of 3-5 pallets: corners, underside, and any broken/missing boards.
Provide a moisture/dryness proof (moisture meter reading or clear evidence of dry storage) and close-ups of any dark patches.
If needed for compliance: photo of the IPPC stamp/marking (HT/MB) on at least one pallet.
response.reason: The photos confirm wooden pallets, but the key pricing drivers (total quantity/weight and condition guarantees like dry/clean/sorted) are not provable from the images or seller text alone.
